status: DRAFT. Proposed alignment between SET7 course packets and the edu-mastery-scorecards cert gate. Needs sign-off from Grok-Edu-Benchmark-Planner owner + Grok-Edu-Mastery-Scorecards.
semantics_warning: Their F0-F4 are per-(course, learner) evidence-card floors (EVIDENCE_CARD_SPEC.md:3,12-19). They are NOT the Buddy frontier F0-F4 tiers that frontier/F0.packet.json is waiting on. Same names, different things.

their_defaults._source: edu-mastery-scorecards/docs/EVIDENCE_CARD_SPEC.md:12-19 (table, 'defaults; per-course cards may raise them'); same numbers in examples/make_examples.py:14-18. cert_gate.py itself hard-codes no min_score; it reads floors from the card (cert_gate.py:54,37).

F3.name: Novel-transfer bench plus a retest after remediation

F4.name: F3, plus a regression retest at least 30 days later by an evaluator independent of the cert issuer

our_floors_source: Packet `floors` object (binding copy). Defaults: SET7_COURSE_MASTERY_FLOORS_AND_HOLDOUT_POLICY.md:52-55,66,117 and skeleton/validate.py:17-20 (unit_practice_min 0.90, course_exit_mean_min 0.90, no_unit_below 0.80, holdout_min 0.90, transfer_tasks_min 1, min_comparable_runs 3, retention_retest_days 7, critical_regressions_max 0).
card_floor_rule: strictest_wins: card min_score = max(their default, our packet floor); card min_days = max(their default, our retention_retest_days). Their spec allows cards to raise floors (EVIDENCE_CARD_SPEC.md:12). Nothing is ever lowered on either side. Null packet floors mean no card (bridge refuses).

F0.note: Our policy has no baseline floor; a baseline is not a mastery claim. Bridge never issues a certificate at any floor.

F2.reps: min_comparable_runs slots; only the largest comparable group (same fixture_hash, grader_version, subject_version) is mapped; empty slots stay unfilled so their gate fails closed

F3.our_floor: holdout_min (validate.py:154 already scores transfer against holdout_min)

F4.our_floor: holdout_min applied fail-closed (SET7 defines NO retention score floor -> OWNER DECISION)

not_expressible_in_their_gate.no_unit_below: Gate has one min_score per floor and no unit concept. Bridge checks it on our side (our_cap).
not_expressible_in_their_gate.comparability: Gate keys benches by bench_id (cert_gate.py:49), so duplicate ids collapse and the last one wins. It has no fixture/grader/subject keys. Bridge maps only one comparable group.
not_expressible_in_their_gate.simulated_runs: Gate has no simulated flag. Bridge drops simulated runs.
not_expressible_in_their_gate.safety_regression_independence: Gate has no such fields (beyond F4 evaluator independence). Bridge checks it on our side.
not_expressible_in_their_gate.sealed_store_status: Gate trusts bench.holdout=true + leakage_check.passed (cert_gate.py:39-43); it never checks a sealed store. Bridge caps at F1 unless holdout_bank.store_status=='active'.

track.school_college: REQUIRES explicit card_track in bundle (k12|stem|college|career); bridge does not guess
track.frontier_f_tier: NO MAPPING (their track enum has no frontier; schema/course_evidence_card.schema.json:12) -> bridge refuses

field_map.learner: bundle.learner {id, type in buddy_adapter|human|model} (schema:14). Required; not derived.
field_map.holdout: true for bank in holdout|transfer|remediation_retest|retention (non-practice gate banks); false for baseline|practice. Interpretation, flagged for owners.
field_map.leakage_check: run.leakage_check; if absent -> {passed:false, method:'NOT RECORDED (bridge fail-closed)'}
field_map.artifact_uri: run.artifact_uri else run.trace_ref else empty (gate fails)
field_map.artifact_sha256: run.artifact_sha256 else empty (gate fails). fixture_hash is NEVER substituted.
field_map.provenance.sources: packet provenance.sources -> {uri: repo:path@commit, license: packet provenance.license (null -> empty -> gate FAIL), consent: bundle.consent (default false -> gate FAIL)}

status._never: certified (certificate issuance belongs to the scorecards issuer; bridge always emits certificate=null)

regression_watch.last_retest_at: latest retention run started_at or null

conflicts_recorded_not_resolved: F1 0.70 / F2-F4 0.80 (EVIDENCE_CARD_SPEC.md:16-19) are below SET7 0.90 (policy:52-54). Not adopted into any packet. The card uses strictest-wins.
Their gate does not stop a card from lowering min_score below the defaults. Verified: F2 min_score 0.1 with score 0.15 -> PASS (cert_gate.py:37 reads spec min_score straight from the card).
A certificate at F0 with a 0-score diagnostic -> PASS (F0 min 0.00, EVIDENCE_CARD_SPEC.md:15). Under SET7:80 that is a vanity cert.
One bench result per bench_id. Duplicate ids collapse, so a failing rep can be hidden (cert_gate.py:49). We require >=3 comparable reps (policy:55).
F4 retest >= 30d (spec:19) vs our retention_retest_days 7 (policy:66,117). Our 'mastered' does NOT imply their F4.
Leakage check is self-declared {passed, method} (cert_gate.py:42). We require a sealed private store, dual control, weekly rotation, burn-on-contamination (policy:91,99,104-106).
Track enums differ (ours bootcamp|school_college|frontier_f_tier; theirs k12|stem|college|career|bootcamp).

Provenance: their gate requires license + consent on every source (cert_gate.py:114-116). All three of our packets have provenance.license=null and no consent field, so every bridged card FAILs until owners fill these in.
